t.144-55-8.agn: It has no EU harmonised classification and is not in any hazard class in the registrants' joint notification. The Turkish Ministry of Health guide names bicarbonate as a safer option for surface cleaning. In food it belongs to the E500 group.
t.144-55-8.reg.clp: No EU harmonised classification. Registrants' joint notification (99.0% of notifications): not classified.
t.144-55-8.what: Scrubs off dirt as a mild abrasive, reduces odours and balances pH.
